snapshot.direction_reference: open of 10:00 start-labelled minute bar, scoring only
snapshot.path: high/low of all 60 start-labelled bars 10:00 through 10:59
snapshot.availability: captured-at plus event-time cutoff; not a claim of historical as-of revisions
snapshot.latency_caveat: Up to 120 seconds of the scored hour can elapse before submission. Jo may browse before saving. This is not an executable 10:00 signal or an equal-information comparison.

range_baseline: At the submission deadline, use the last completed minute close times (1 + Q20 historical downside, 1 + Q80 historical upside). Historical full-window extrema are relative to each historical deadline-minute close. No partial-window shortening. Snapshot-time historical width remains the per-case forecast cap.
opening_continuation: classify last completed minute close at submission deadline / 09:30 open - 1 using the original frozen sideways threshold

sample.half_days: include if open at 09:30 and close at or after 11:00
sample.calendar: Alpaca market calendar, exact 22 sessions registered before first development forecast

missing_policy: Any evaluation session with at least one missing, late, invalid or data-missing forecast counts once. More than 3 invalidates and stops this version. No automatic extension/restart; any restart needs a new prospective protocol and owner authorization. All 140 cases remain in participation denominator.
outcome_policy: One scheduled capture at 11:05 with bounded transport pagination, no outcome-selection retries. Missing outcomes invalidate final judgment; never silently drop them or interpolate missing bars.
development_policy: Two plumbing sessions only, no predictive scoring. If either session has a platform-evidenced task start after 10:00:30, choose the preregistered +5 minute schedule before evaluation, without looking at outcomes. Otherwise retain 10:00/10:02. Missing start evidence or missing development delivery blocks evaluation for owner review. No extra development forecasts or automatic CLI fallback. Record the choice once before the first evaluation session.

timing_policy.shifted: 10:05 snapshot using bars completed by 10:04; 10:07 deadline; 11:00 endpoint. Evaluation horizon is then 55 minutes. Sideways/history/range baselines use that same 10:05-to-11:00 window. Two minutes of outcome may elapse before submission in either schedule.
timing_policy.evaluation_choice: immutable before first evaluation session; no shifts during evaluation

evaluation_policy: No interim outcome scoring or per-case outcome inspection. Operational status only. Score once after all 20 registered sessions. No tuning, selective reruns or historical substitutions.
decision: Both forecast gates plus participation and integrity must pass to earn consideration of independent replication; otherwise stop directional development under this version. Never automatic promotion or activation.

model.provider: Hosted Jo / Dots on ChatGPT subscription
model.settings: Freeze actual task settings at activation; unavailable controls recorded unavailable
model.metadata: Record platform-reported model identity when available; never trust model self-identification. Flag observed changes; undetectable changes remain a limitation.
model.context: Jo may use web, memory and concurrent-task context before the server deadline. Baselines have deadline price bars but no equivalent news input.
model.claim: Evaluation of hosted Jo under a frozen task protocol, with unpinned model and documented context limits

web_policy.report: web access not restricted; bounded by deadline
web_policy.enforcement: Server timestamps classify saves after the deadline as late, never answered or abstained. Immutable retries preserve original time. No task-scoped web restriction or trace gate.
web_policy.evidence: Do not accept Jo self-report as evidence of tools used, browsing absence or model identity.
web_policy.limitation: Deadline bounds save time, not information equality. News, memory and concurrent-task context are not reproduced in simple price baselines; a pass is not evidence of a leakage-controlled forecast.

runtime.adapter: VPS non-model collection/scoring and isolated forecast exchange; hosted subscription-only Jo development activation requires verified connection
runtime.fallback: Codex subscription CLI only with separate owner approval; not installed or invoked by this preparation

unresolved: Bind a new forecast-only OAuth identity/connection without production grants
Verify existing SIP entitlement without purchase
Freeze actual task settings and exact future calendar; activate only two development sessions
boundaries: No production services, database, production Jo task, Shadow exchange or pre-trade changes
Subscription only; no inference API or CLI fallback
Exactly two development sessions after connection checks; evaluation requires separate activation after timing evidence

baseline_capture.last_bar: minute starting one minute before submission_deadline
baseline_capture.missing_policy: Missing or invalid deadline baseline for any existing snapshot invalidates judgment; no substitution with earlier baseline or later outcomes
baseline_capture.source: Independent Alpaca SIP capture with exact completed-minute grid; hashed create-only files; no Jo claims
baseline_capture.availability: Event-time cutoff, capture within 30 seconds after deadline; not a guarantee of historical as-of revisions or equal news access
